info.title: Service Topology API
info.summary: Illustrative contract for the future backend. No server implements it yet.
info.description: Draft contract (see docs/API_CONTRACT.md). Each operation lists the frontend repository method it backs in `x-repository`. Payload schemas are the published JSON Schemas in docs/schemas; contract tests validate the mock data and the examples here against them. Authentication, tenancy, rate limits and retention are open decisions and intentionally not specified. Every operation may also return 401/403 (authentication, ADR-018), 429 with Retry-After (rate limit), and 503 (database unavailable) as problem details.

get.summary: Canonical topology, optionally scoped to one environment.
get.description: Without `environmentId`, returns every environment (what the mock repository returns today). Environment-independent resources (e.g. SaaS APIs) are always included. Referential integrity follows validateTopology.

parameters.name: environmentId
parameters.description: Project the topology onto one environment: that environment record; all service definitions; instances in it; resources in it (own or inherited) plus environment-independent ones; relationships between kept entities; event types carried in it, with channels narrowed to kept ones. The projection passes the same validation. Unknown environment: 404.

get.summary: Paginated search over instances and communicating resources (registry rows).
get.description: Server-side equivalent of buildRegistryRows + filterRegistryRows + sortRegistryRows. Filters combine with AND across parameters and OR within a list.
get.x-repository: proposed RegistryRepository.search (today computed client-side from getTopology)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: All whitespace-separated terms must match name, ID, owner, or team (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's nextCursor. Valid only with the same environmentId, q, filters, and sort (otherwise 400). Offset-based: if the topology changes between pages, rows may shift.

post.description: Writes validate the whole resulting topology with the client's rules (validateTopology) plus the schema's enums and required fields (code `invalid-field`); failures are 422 with `errors[]`. Server-set fields: `updatedAt` is the write time; telemetry (`metrics`) cannot be written (new entities have none, replacements keep the stored values). Requires the editor role when AUTH_MODE=token. The ID must be new across all collections (409 otherwise).

get.summary: One canonical entity by kind and ID (deep links, inspector).
get.x-repository: proposed; today resolved from the TopologyIndex

put.description: Writes validate the whole resulting topology with the client's rules (validateTopology) plus the schema's enums and required fields (code `invalid-field`); failures are 422 with `errors[]`. Server-set fields: `updatedAt` is the write time; telemetry (`metrics`) cannot be written (new entities have none, replacements keep the stored values). Requires the editor role when AUTH_MODE=token. The body's `id` must equal the path ID (IDs cannot change).

delete.description: Refused with 422 while other entities still reference it: `errors[]` lists each blocking reference (validateTopology codes such as `missing-environment`). Requires the editor role when AUTH_MODE=token.

post.summary: Store a snapshot (e.g. a capture of the simulation).

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null at the end.

errors.description: Validation issues. Topology codes are those of validateTopology; snapshots add invalid-snapshot, layouts invalid-layout; malformed parameters use invalid-parameter.

requestId.description: Extension member: the request ID (also in the X-Request-ID response header), for correlating with server logs.

DependencyEntry.description: One entity at its shortest distance (breadth-first; relationships tried in ID order).

truncated.description: True when more entries exist than `limit`.

ImpactResult.description: Read-only what-if per the propagation rules (simulated reasoning, not a prediction).

instanceId.description: null when the definition is not deployed in the environment.

relationshipIds.description: Path between instance and channel; empty when not connected.

viaQueueId.description: Queue bound to an exchange channel that the consumer reads from.

durationTicks.description: inject: recover automatically after this many ticks (0 = no scheduled recovery).

ticks.description: step: ticks to advance (10 simulated seconds each).

SimulationRequest.description: An isolated, deterministic run of the simulation engine on a read-only copy of the canonical topology (ADR-016). Bounds: ≤ 100 actions, ≤ 500 ticks in total, ≤ 5 watched entities.

watch.description: Entities whose simulated metrics are recorded as telemetry at every tick.

captureSnapshot.description: Store the final state as a snapshot with source "simulation" (ID = run ID).

clock.description: Simulated clock at the end of the run, not wall-clock time.

sourceType.description: Where the stored topology came from, e.g. "fixture". Only "observed" data is not mock.

WritableEntityKind.description: Entity kinds accepted by the write operations (ADR-020): the selection kinds plus event-type and business-flow (ADR-022). Imported business flows are read-only (409 imported-read-only).

bearerAuth.description: Required on /api/v1 when the server runs with AUTH_MODE=token (ADR-018): reader tokens may call GET operations, editor tokens all operations. Missing/invalid token: 401; read-only token on a write: 403. With AUTH_MODE=none the API must only listen on loopback or behind an authenticating proxy.

ETag.description: Topology revision as a strong entity tag. Send it back in If-Match on writes.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Topology revision (ETag of GET /topology or of the previous write). When present and no longer current, the write is refused with 412 so concurrent edits are not lost. Omit to write unconditionally.
